exposure: Prenatal echocardiography findings (appearance of septum primum and FO flap)
cohort: Fetuses diagnosed with D-TGA who underwent fetal echocardiography at a tertiary hospital between January 2018 and May 2023, with 48 cases included after exclusions.
finding: Prenatal echocardiography performed after 37 weeks of gestation in fetuses with D-TGA, specifically FO diameter ≤ 6 mm and VSD diameter ≤ 3.2 mm, provides valuable information to estimate the need for postnatal urgent BAS.
followup_time: N/A (outcomes measured postnatally, implying immediately after birth for urgent BAS)
gest_age: After 37 weeks of gestation (timing of prenatal echocardiography)
